articles.title: Samsung's New Watch Tries to Score Your Health Like a Video Game
articles.summary: Samsung's Galaxy Watch9 can track your sleep, heart, and even your hearing. It starts at $80 and lasts about 25 hours per charge. But is all that health data actually helpful?

articles.title: Tennis Star Wins Big After a Last-Minute Call-Up
articles.summary: British tennis player Samuel won his Davis Cup debut after Cameron Norrie got injured. He fought back from a set down to win. Britain now leads 2-0.

articles.title: Afghanistan: Land of High Mountains, Kite Fights, and Snow Leopards
articles.summary: Afghanistan is a country in Central Asia with tall mountains and dry deserts. Kids there fly kites and even have kite fights. Snow leopards live in the cold mountains.
